## Description

Apply ADR-013. Keep `src/`, `web/`, `tests/`, `infra/`, `tools/` and `packages/` where they are (renaming them for taste costs hundreds of reference edits for no benefit). Add what the roadmap needs, and create a folder only when the ticket that builds it starts (no empty scaffolding). Do it inside the schema-change freeze that MDV-P0-033 needs: this ticket merges first, then MDV-P0-033 builds the baseline migration. Use `git mv`; one PR per chunk; CI green after each; chunk 3 goes last because it rewrites paths the others touch.
Chunk 1, Host.Api to composition only: the feature endpoints in `src/Host.Api` (AuditLog, Invitations, Notifications, Onboarding, Settings, Staff) move into module Api projects (AuditLog to Audit, Invitations and Staff to Identity, Notifications to a new Notifications.Api, Settings and Onboarding to Tenancy or a new Practice module if they span modules). Host keeps Program.cs, Auth/BFF, Context, Middleware, Observability, PublicSite and module registration. An architecture test fails when Host holds endpoints, services or entities of a feature.
Chunk 2, workspace and shared packages: `mobile/*` added to pnpm-workspace.yaml with the rules in ADR-013; `packages/tokens` split out of `packages/ui` (CSS variables for web, a theme object for native); `packages/api-client` generated from the OpenAPI document that Host.Api exports at build time, with a CI drift check; the two `parts.tsx` files split into named components; lint import boundaries for packages (no package imports an app, native packages never import web UI).
Chunk 3, docs consolidation: `tickets/` becomes `docs/05-delivery/tickets/` and `design/` becomes `docs/02-design/source/`; every reference in tools (tickets build, gh_issues footer, prd-extract, ERD), CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README and docs is rewritten; CI gains a relative-link check.
Chunk 4, CI and docs: path filters per area (backend, web, mobile, packages, infra, docs), CODEOWNERS and dependabot paths, `docs/03-architecture/repository-structure.md` and README updated to the real tree, layout rules added to AGENTS.md.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given `src/Host.Api`, when the architecture test runs, then it fails if endpoints, services or entities of a feature are present, and passes with only composition, auth/BFF, middleware, observability and the public site.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given each moved endpoint group, when its existing tests run, then they pass unchanged and every endpoint still declares a policy or is explicitly public.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given `packages/api-client` or the exported OpenAPI document, when either drifts from the API, then CI fails.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, when `pnpm install` runs, then `web/*`, `mobile/*` and `packages/*` resolve and no package imports an app.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the whole repo, when the link checker runs, then there are zero broken relative links and CI runs it.
- [ ] **AC6.** Given the repository root, when listed, then `tickets/` and `design/` are gone and everything they held is under docs.
- [ ] **AC7.** Given a change to one area, when CI runs, then only the affected jobs run and the required checks still gate the merge.
- [ ] **AC8.** Given the new tree, when `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm -r lint`, `pnpm -r test`, `pnpm e2e` and `python3 -I tools/tickets/build.py` run, then all pass.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
